raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Associate Project Manager / Product Manager | Provana India Private Limited · Noida
April 2024 - Present
Reported directly to Directors and worked closely with the EVP of the Healthcare vertical, building trusted executive relationships to drive consensus and roadmap alignment. Coordinated delivery across Engineering, Architecture, Design, Database, BI/Analytics, and Marketing.
Own the full product lifecycle - discovery, user research, requirements gathering, PRDs, design collaboration, Agile development, and post-launch operations - for an AI-driven RCM platform integrating Eligibility Verification, Charge Entry, Claims, Prior Authorization, Payment Posting, and Denial Management.
Build and maintain trusted relationships with executive stakeholders (Directors, EVP), facilitating weekly roadmap reviews and driving consensus on prioritization and trade-off decisions at the leadership level.
Drive cross-functional alignment and consensus across Engineering, Architecture, Design, Database, BI/Analytics, and Marketing - influencing outcomes across teams without direct authority, resolving competing priorities and delivery blockers.
Designed a central workflow orchestration platform using historical data and a configurable rule engine to dynamically allocate and prioritize work - replacing fragmented manual tracking and establishing a reusable pattern for future automation.
Applied data-driven decision-making throughout the product lifecycle - using performance and adoption data, not opinion, to guide prioritization and validate feature impact.
Built and launched an AI + rule-engine Charge Entry Automation product processing unstructured documents end-to-end, achieving ~80% reduction in manual effort and improving accuracy at scale.
Delivered a Payment Posting Automation product linking data extraction, reconciliation, and posting workflows, driving ~45% reduction in manual effort and accelerating cycle completion.
Shipped an AI-powered chatbot product to build internal product awareness and reduce dependency on tribal knowledge across operations teams.
Led FHIR API and HL7 integration initiatives connecting EHR, PMS, Clearinghouse, and Payer systems; managed ANSI X12 270/271 eligibility verification and EDI 278 prior authorization workflows.
Led vendor and market research for a multi-vendor consolidation initiative, evaluating capabilities across providers to inform platform strategy and standardize workflows.
Defined and tracked product KPIs - claim acceptance rates, adjudication cycle times, charge entry accuracy - via Power BI dashboards, enabling real-time, data-driven decisions for executive leadership.
New Product Initiative (Multi-Agent AI Platform): Co-leading requirements definition for a new B2B SaaS platform in financial operations: a multi-agent AI orchestration product built on Azure AI Services, with configurable workflows enabling business users to orchestrate agent-driven processes. Currently in active development, with 4 agents live and client pilot testing scheduled for November 2026. 2018 - March 2024
Product & Operations Manager  |  Raaj Medisafe India Limited  ·  Indore
Pharma / FMCG. Led product strategy and business operations over a 6-year growth mandate, combining go-to-
market execution with P&L ownership.
Scaled annual revenue by 250% over 6 years through strategic go-to-market planning, client acquisition, and data-driven operational decisions.
Owned prioritization and trade-off decisions across business and operational initiatives, balancing cost, ROI, and resource constraints to drive profitability.
Managed P&L-focused business planning, partnering with finance on cost-benefit analysis and benefits realization across strategic initiatives.
